errors.text_span: Словакия (оранжева линия), Унгария (жълта линия), Словения (тъмно жълта линия) и Чехия (синя линия)
errors.evidence: The mapping of countries to line colors is incorrect. Slovakia is light blue (not orange), Hungary is orange (not yellow), and Slovenia is yellow (not dark yellow). Also, Czechia is dark blue, while Slovakia is light blue; simply calling Czechia's line "blue" is ambiguous.
The starting point for Poland (grey line) is approximately (48, 45), not (35, 55). The described X-coordinate is significantly incorrect.
The starting point for Slovakia (light blue line) is approximately (48, 38), not (40, 35). The described X-coordinate is significantly incorrect.

errors.text_span: Линията на Унгария започва приблизително при (45;50) и завършва при (73,1; 73,9).
errors.evidence: The line for Hungary (orange) ends at approximately (63, 65). The coordinate label (73.1; 73.9) is located near the line for Slovakia (light blue), not the line for Hungary.
The starting point for Slovenia (yellow line) is approximately (70, 70), not (65, 60). Both coordinates are incorrect.
The starting point for Czechia (dark blue line) is approximately (62, 40), not (55, 40). The X-coordinate is significantly incorrect.
The description omits the black diagonal line running from (30,30) to (100,100), which represents a hypothetical full price convergence and is a key visual element of the chart.
